composition_variation: Illustrate an original 36-year-old anime woman with a thick dark side braid, seated comfortably on a tall stool in an empty record shop. She wears an opaque ocher turtleneck, deep teal vest, loose full-length cream trousers, and loafers. One elbow rests lightly on a wooden counter and both feet are supported. Use warm risograph textures, dusty plum shadows, and a confident amused expression, with all record sleeves blank. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
